summary: The poster “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” celebrates the achievements of three space explorers: Opportunity, Curiosity, and Voyager. Opportunity explored Mars, Curiosity studied the planet's environment and geology, while Voyager travelled beyond the solar system to explore interstellar space. Despite their missions facing challenges or eventually ending, their discoveries, scientific data, and contributions remain valuable to humanity. Their legacy reminds us that exploration never truly ends, as knowledge continues to inspire future generations and expand our understanding of the universe.
details: Team Genius Space,” benefits society by increasing awareness and knowledge about space exploration and scientific discoveries. Its main purpose is to remind people that even when space missions end, their contributions are never forgotten. We aim to inspire young generations to develop an interest in science, technology and space exploration. We used digital design software and AI-assisted tools to create an attractive poster with futuristic visuals, neon colours and space-themed elements. Our project is creative because it presents three famous space explorers, Opportunity, Curiosity and Voyager, as legends with different roles and achievements. Throughout the development process, our team considered the accuracy of information, creativity, educational value, visual presentation and the interests of our target audience.
